slots.panel: absolute inset-e-0 top-full z-30 mt-2 flex w-96 max-w-[calc(100vw-2rem)] flex-col gap-3 rounded-md border border-divider bg-surface-overlay p-4 shadow-lg
slots.head: flex items-start justify-between gap-3
slots.title: text-sm font-medium text-fg
slots.recording: flex items-center gap-3 rounded-md bg-danger-bg py-2 ps-3 pe-2 text-danger-fg

slots.chipRemove: inline-flex size-6 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full text-fg-secondary hover:bg-divider hover:text-fg active:bg-divider focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus
